Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Age of Fronts strategy-game building icon, 1254 x 1254 RGBA PNG.
Primary request: Create one top-down BLACKSMITH production building for the specified age, matching the supplied game art.
Input images: Image 1 is the matching-age palette/material reference; Image 2 is the exact overhead camera, detailed hand-painted texture, compact workshop-and-yard composition reference. Change the subject to a blacksmith, do not copy the siege weapons.
Style/medium: Polished realistically hand-painted game asset, crisp readable shapes at icon size, tactile weathered wood, stone, metal and roof materials, natural restrained colors, soft short ambient shadows.
Camera/framing: STRICT 90-degree vertically overhead orthographic plan view. All parallel edges stay parallel. Roof ridges centered with symmetric slopes, no perspective or foreshortening. Only roof surfaces, chimney top openings, narrow wall tops, yard floor and the top surfaces of equipment are visible. No broad vertical front walls, window elevations, standing facades, front-facing gables or isometric view. One compact coherent facility on a small square-ish ground patch, aligned with canvas axes and centered, about 88-92 percent of the canvas, with generous transparent margins on every side. Do not crop any corner.
Background: Genuine transparent alpha outside the irregular bounded ground patch, no black, white or checkerboard painted background. No opaque surrounding landscape.
Constraints: No people, text, labels, insignia, watermark or large smoke plume. Visible forge, anvil and metalworking benches must identify it as a smithy. No siege machines, mine shafts or unrelated buildings.
Age: Bronze Age.
Subject and materials: A modest mudbrick and timber metalworking workshop with a warm ochre flat earthen roof and a small straw-roofed storage shelter. In its open packed-earth work yard, show a compact clay charcoal furnace with glowing embers viewed through its circular top, clay crucibles, bronze ingots, copper-colored metal stock, stone casting molds, and a squat stone anvil with hammer on a stump. Include a water jar, charcoal basket, and sturdy wooden workbench with tongs. Low rough mudbrick boundary, sandy ground with a few sparse edge plants. The roof must be a plan-view rectangle with an adobe parapet visible from above; do not show a front facade.

Image 1 is the blacksmith icon to correct. Image 2 shows the target camera: true vertical overhead, workshop roof and courtyard visible, almost no vertical building wall.

There must be no front-facing furnace opening, no exposed vertical fireplace hood or tall front face. The blacksmith remains immediately readable through the hearth, anvil and tools.
No text, people, watermark, perspective, isometric angle or painted background. Preserve transparent margins on all sides.
